metadata.methods_description: EEG data were collected while participants performed go-nogo tasks in a dimly lit room seated 110 cm from a computer screen. Visual stimuli (8-bit color photographs, 256×384 pixels, ~4.5° × 6.5° visual angle) were presented for 20 ms at 100 Hz refresh rate. Participants responded via a touch-sensitive button (response latency <1 ms) with 1000 ms response window and 2000 ms stimulus onset asynchrony (±200 ms jitter). Two recording sessions occurred on separate days (13 series on day 1, 12 series on day 2, 100 images per series). Tasks included animal categorization (respond to animal images) and recognition (respond to learned probe image).
